claims.claim: You can apply for Statutory Maternity Pay by phone.
claims.note: The text says you claim SMP by telling your employer and giving notice and proof of pregnancy, but never says you can do this by phone; the phone numbers given are for disputes.

claims.claim: You can apply for Statutory Maternity Pay by post.
claims.quote: You must give them at least 28 days’ notice (in writing if they ask for it) and proof that you’re pregnant.
claims.note: The text says notice may be given to your employer in writing, but does not say you can apply by post.
